# cubepath_baremetal_models (Data Source)

Lists the baremetal server models on sale (model_name of cubepath_baremetal), with price and stock.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location_name` (String) Only list the models of this location.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `models` (Attributes List) Models on sale. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String) CPU.
- `discount_type` (String) Discount type: fixed or percentage.
- `discount_value` (Number) Discount.
- `disk_size` (String) Disks (for example 2x960GB).
- `disk_type` (String) Disk type.
- `location_name` (String) Location.
- `model_name` (String) Model name.
- `port_gbps` (Number) Network port speed, in Gbps.
- `price` (Number) Monthly price before discount.
- `ram_size` (Number) RAM, in GB.
- `ram_type` (String) RAM type.
- `setup` (Number) Setup fee.
- `stock_available` (Number) Servers in stock.
